title: Cardinality of the complex numbers
statement: Let $\mathbf C=\mathbf R\oplus i\mathbf R$, $i^2=-1$, be the usual complex field [def-weil-field]. Its underlying set has cardinality $|\mathbf C|=2^{\aleph_0}$, where $|S|$ denotes the cardinality of a set $S$ and $\aleph_0=|\mathbf N|$.
